newsitem.title: USA: Universal Intl Feb same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Universal Intl Feb same-store sales off.

text.p: Universal International Inc said same-store sales for its retail stores declined 7.3 percent in February on a comparable 28-day basis and were down 4.1 percent for the first two months of the year.
The parent of Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail stores said total February sales rose 25.7 percent to $4.3 million from $3.5 million a year earlier.
Cumulative total sales for the two months ended February 28 were up 30.9 percent to $8.3 million from $6.3 million in 1996.

"February comparable store sales results were in line with expectations given that February 1996 comparable store sales were up 24.1 percent due to heavy discounting of 1995 seasonal product and a grand re-opening promotional campaign for the Twin Cities market area that was not repeated this year," chief executive officer Mark Ravich said in a statement.
Universal International buys and sells "close-out" merchandise.
